maddeler.e:
استنزفوا (form X)
# اِسْتَنْزَفُوا (istanzafū) /is.tan.za.fuː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِسْتَنْزَفَ (istanzafa)
# اُسْتُنْزِفُوا (ustunzifū) /us.tun.zi.fuː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِسْتَنْزَفَ (istanzafa)
# اِسْتَنْزِفُوا (istanzifū) /is.tan.zi.fuː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِسْتَنْزَفَ (istanzafa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
